competition_track: LLM - Detect AI Generated Text, Efficiency Prize (7th place solution by davin11/wcqyfly)
architecture: Byte-level BPE (vocab 50275) + 3-5 token n-gram TF-IDF (sublinear tf) + MultinomialNB(alpha=0.0225) and SGDClassifier(modified_huber) soft vote, weights [0.43, 0.57]
adaptation_status: Original model definition (model_ensemble.py) and tokenizer/TF-IDF settings used unchanged; data, split, and tokenizer-fit partition adapted (see adaptations). Not the original competition submission.
adaptations: Trained on CS747data.csv instead of the competition's DAIGT/argugpt/commonlit sources.
Own stratified 80/10/10 split (seed 747) after dropping essays < 50 chars, exact normalized duplicates and conflicting labels; NOT the repository's frozen 70/15/15 + unseen-source split.
BPE tokenizer and TF-IDF vocabulary fit on the own-split validation essays (original: on the competition test essays); IDF fit on the own-split training essays.
SGD trained epoch by epoch with partial_fit and fit()'s stopping rule (tol 1e-4, n_iter_no_change 5); stopped after 6 epochs.
leakage_warning: The own 80/10/10 split draws ~80% of every source into training, including the sources the repository reserves for unseen_test. Most repository test/unseen_test essays were therefore seen during training; standardized evaluator scores for this model are optimistic and not comparable with frozen-split models.
own_split_metrics_note: Measured on the own-split test set (15458 essays), not the repository's frozen split.
artifact_format: Plain numpy arrays + dict (no sklearn objects), exported from run_7th.py's pipeline.joblib by export_artifacts.py; MultinomialNB.feature_count_ dropped (unused at inference).
